summary: Comprehensive testing of Subscription System. Backend: 15/15 tests passed - all subscription endpoints working correctly. Frontend: Subscriptions page, Navbar link, and Admin stats all verified working.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (width/height -1) - cosmetic issue, charts still render

GET_SUBSCRIPTIONS_PLANS.description: Returns 3 plans with correct prices (£25, £50, £100) and entries (2, 5, 12)

GET_MY_SUBSCRIPTION.description: Returns null subscription when not subscribed, or active subscription details

GET_MY_SUBSCRIPTION_TICKETS.description: Returns list of tickets received via subscription

POST_SUBSCRIPTION_PURCHASE_WALLET.description: Correctly fails with insufficient balance error when wallet balance < plan price

POST_SUBSCRIPTION_PURCHASE_VIVA.description: Returns checkout_url for Viva payment when user doesn't have active subscription

POST_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL.description: Returns 404 when no active subscription, or cancels auto-renewal successfully

GET_ADMIN_SUBSCRIPTIONS.description: Admin can view all subscriptions with proper fields

SUBSCRIPTIONS_PAGE_FRONTEND.description: Page loads with 3 plan cards showing correct prices (£25, £50, £100), entries (2, 5, 12 bilete), wallet buttons, and card payment buttons

NAVBAR_ABONAMENTE_LINK.description: Navbar has 'Abonamente' link with Crown icon, visible on all pages, navigates to /subscriptions

PLAN_CARDS_WALLET_BALANCE.description: Plan cards show wallet balance and correctly disable wallet button when insufficient (shows 'Wallet insuficient (£0.00)')

CUM_FUNCTIONEAZA_SECTION.description: 'Cum Functioneaza?' section displayed at bottom of subscriptions page with 4 steps

ADMIN_SUBSCRIPTION_STATS_UI.description: Admin Wallet tab shows Abonamente section with Active, Total, Venituri (Revenue), Bilete Distribuite stats

UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS_PROTECTION.description: All authenticated endpoints return 401 without auth token

critical_code_review_comments: Subscription system is well-implemented with 3 fixed plans as specified
Auto-distribution of tickets to competitions with price ≤ £3.99 is implemented (background task)
Auto-renewal from wallet is implemented (subscription_renewal_bot runs on timer)
Both wallet and Viva card payment methods are supported
Admin can view all subscriptions and stats in the Wallet tab
Proper authentication and authorization on all endpoints
Frontend has proper data-testid attributes for testing
